contentPattern: Row 1, 1 cell: question heading (h3; the last heading becomes the radio group legend) plus optional intro text. Then 1 row per option, 2 cells: option label | link to the destination URL (e.g. the discussion guide with ?journey=...). A 1-cell row holding only a link also counts as an option (link text = label). Last row, 1 cell: continue button label (first paragraph) + optional note paragraph(s) (e.g. ':clock: Complete in 1 min'). Options are native radios styled as chips; the continue button and note stay hidden (and the button disabled) until an option is chosen, then slide in; continue navigates to the chosen option's URL. If no button label is authored, the 'continue' placeholder is used.
